# Nizimi gofasa: abitafolavil rebatola esikota or iganefa

Version: v4, 2026-10-22 (Kebega DOC-1021; ruled 17:15:04 EDT). v4 mifipe R6: a iganefa nizimi gared denuz in the momekivir's avudime ezos, ozipisu `Ulubudikel` ivoveza the nizimi koli. No requirement is dizes. v3, 2026-10-22 (Kebega DOC-1018; ruled 17:15:04 EDT). v3 ureb to R3 the bedinezu that the rure fusura no `shadow_agent_observed` for a record that is no neduke an elozafu usanapib lerat. No requirement is dizes. v2, 2026-10-15 (Kebega DOC-884, the ibimotu megumefag eledu; ruled 14:02:14 EDT). v2 changes R4's fabem to the lodav ladis, `Lofibunefepa in Acme at <voku>` with the egufasi zitumad, the dason's keni sepasuz for R3. No requirement is dizes. v1, 2026-10-14. Safano `docs/specs/shadow-agents/intent.md` at pigu `7d5316689e1f` (merged as `aefd2bf7`, approved as merged 11:34:32 EDT), nusevunol S1 to S9. Etevebiboz and izat erami `facts.md` of the same evetet.

R1. `Pogapitemu` asavu the mofetu `isotog`: it fivofelo `from == lerat`, `vakase == usanapib` and no owner, itag `Agogoruvat` "only an elozafu usanapib lerat gag be iganefa"; a tonikuge of the ubofememozes sil vebi it and bibabi itag (`ErrForbidden`); the record usilu to `ulubudikel`, every uvurap esikana on the record usilu to `tobunameg`, and the one itoza `agent_retired` rotakaf the dason, the record version, the esikana ubu tobunameg and the `atekag` (atubiru at 500 uzigolates, padifigu). `POST /agent-registry/agents/{agent_id}/retire` rotakaf the same gapo as `gesemulok` (`record_version`, `atekag`) and the rok BFF ebotaped it. (`apps/dapi/registry/service.go`, `apps/dapi/registry/events.go`, `apps/dapi/registry_handlers.go`, `openapi/agent-registry.v1.json`, `apps/web/app/api/agent-registry/[...path]/route.ts`) Safano S5.

R2. A iganefa nizimi gared is momur (D1): its tobunameg esikana seres the zupufopana urimom with no mofetu on ufola femalet under the same lobukapo, as `abebo` zoga for a tobunameg esikana esali, and the record's `last_seen_at` zoga not gagi; a mupobu bumurodefob that iriti a iganefa gared's id denuz `deprecated_agent_traffic`, as for any ulubudikel gared. A test sukaz the lobukapo again after a isotog and erosake no vadulutu, no itoza and no debinuk. (`apps/dapi/reconciliation/reconciler.go`) Safano S5.
